meta.notes: hero_core = Core Collection unlock table: collecting N heroes unlocks March Size bonus for core slot type. effect_id 40001 = March Size (from effect_num_des). lw_hero_rank = Hero star rank progression: each rank grants flat Hero HP/Attack/Defense (from lw_effect_number). lw_hero_honorLevel = Hero Honor Level (0-600): per-level Hero HP grants scaled by hero quality tier (1-5). stat 50063 = Hero HP, 50007 = Hero Attack, 50009 = Hero Defense.
